description: Write every attachment of a .msg, .eml or winmail.dat file into a folder and return the paths. An attached email (.msg inside .msg) is saved as a .msg file, which read_email can then open.

output_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder to write into. Created if missing; existing files are never overwritten.

path.description: Absolute path to a .msg, .eml or winmail.dat file.

name: save_attachments
title: Save attachments from an email file
